newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden still establishing credibility - Backstrom.
newsitem.headline: Sweden still establishing credibility - Backstrom.

text.p: Swedish central bank governor Urban Backstrom said in a statement that Italy's and earlier Finland's participation in the ERM did not affect Sweden's position.
Backstrom was in Brussels for the meeting of European Unbion finance ministers at which the Italian lira was readmitted to the Exchange Rate Mechanism on Sunday.
The Riksbank, the central bank, issued a statement in Stockholm quoting him as saying:
"Italy's and Finland's decision does not affect Sweden's position in this matter.

"In recent years the imbalances in Sweden's economy have been reduced and government finance is improving rapidly. Sweden's credibility as a country with low inflation is on the way to being established. Sweden therefore has a good possibility of fulfilling the conditions for membership of the EMU.

"Participation in the ERM requires a period of stability in the Swedish economy. Broad support in society for the krona's adherence to the ERM is also necessary. Membership of the ERM is not on the agenda for now."
